messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the slimmed hosting API RFC — proposal attached. I think we should converge on a minimal control plane surface that only expresses: capability set, preferred model family, routing policy hint, and KMS key reference. Everything else gets pushed to runtime-specific opaque config. Thoughts?
aj: +1 on the principle. We need a migration path so current Dedicated customers don't get surprise behaviour. Suggest a compatibility layer that maps deprecated fields to the new capability set.
maria: Agreed — compatibility layer (server-side) for 6 months. After that, we flip warnings to errors.
tom: One tradeoff: if we make the surface too minimal, we lose the ability to do per-deployment autoscaling hints and QoS guarantees. Those are important for Dedicated SLAs. Could we include an optional `performance_profile` enum?
linh: Optional `performance_profile` SGTM, but keep it as an opaque enum: `latency-99`, `throughput-optimized`, `burst-friendly`. Runtimes can interpret. That avoids exposing low-level autoscaling knobs.
sara: KMS concerns: Private customers want explicit KMS flow hooks (HSM + local network). If we only carry a `kms_ref`, we must ensure the runtime can resolve multiple KMS backends. Document that resolution is out-of-band and the control plane only stores an opaque pointer.
maria: Good call. We'll add a small section in the spec: `kms_ref` is an opaque string, resolution is a deployment concern. We'll also require explicit audit events when a runtime resolves the pointer.
aj: Ops/rollout idea: 1) add `serving.contract.v2` 2) implement server-side shim that consumes old fields and emits v2 3) run double-write for 2 weeks (control plane exposes both) 4) enable canary enforcement on 5% of traffic 5) flip global enforcement after 6 weeks.
linh: For testing: need a compatibility test harness that validates that the shim mapping yields identical runtime config for a representative set of tenants. If we can't guarantee parity we must fallback to permissive mode.
sara: Security review item: make sure the shim doesn't accidentally escalate privileges by mapping restricted `network_policy` to an open default. Default should be deny-first.
maria: +1 deny-first. Also want to keep the ability for Dedicated to annotate a runtime with `isolation_tier` so routing can prefer isolated pools. This stays optional.
tom: Question about telemetry: if we move many fields to runtime-opaque blobs, will observability suffer? We need standardized tracing labels: `serving.contract.version`, `capabilities`, `isolation_tier`, `kms_resolved` (boolean). Runtimes must emit those.
infra-bot: deploy: staged rollout started for service/controlplane v3.2.1 to infra-canary (2025-09-13T09:12Z).
aj: We should include a small example of the new minimal manifest in the RFC thread. Quick draft: ```json
{
  "serving_contract": "v2",
  "capabilities": ["text-generation","chat","embeddings"],
  "model_family_hint": "gptx-open-compat",
  "performance_profile": "latency-99",
  "kms_ref": "kms://proj-123/key/abc",
  "routing_hint": "region:us-west-2",
  "opaque_runtime_config": "base64(...)"
}
```
linh: Nice. For `opaque_runtime_config` require a maximum size (128KB) and a well-defined checksum header so control plane can detect accidental corruption.
maria: Add `opaque_config_checksum` and `opaque_config_size`. Also require that opaque blobs are base64 and signed by tenant (optionally) to prove origin.
sara: Migration checklist for accounts team: - notify tenants with `network_policy` fields - create automated mapping table - add `deny-first` fallback - prepare KB article with example mappings
aj: And migration tooling: `redwood migrate-manifest --from=v1 --to=v2 --dry-run` that outputs diffs and a confidence score based on heuristics.
ton: (typo) tom: small nit: we should validate `capabilities` against a catalog so we can route to compatible runtimes. It's fine to be extensible with a `custom:` prefix.
linh: For private deployments we need an escape hatch: allow admins to opt-out of automatic shim translation and ingest raw v1 manifests directly. We'll gate this behind `enterprise_feature: true`.
maria: Decision log proposal: - Accept minimal serving contract v2 with fields above - Implement server-side shim + dry-run migration tooling - 6 month deprecation window with gradual enforcement - Dedicated/Private get `performance_profile` and `isolation_tier` optional annotations - KMS remains an opaque pointer with mandated audit events - Observability labels standardized
aj: I'll draft the follow-up RFC section and a rollout playbook. Can someone pair on the compatibility test harness?
linh: I can take initial tests, will need tenant samples from support.
maría: thanks all, I'll update the RFC and ping infra to queue the canary. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: reminder: deploy window scheduled 2025-09-14 02:00-04:00 UTC for control plane changes. Please ack if you need exceptions.
